Quick update from staging prep  hit a blocking issue provisioning the model shard for the SKU cardinality the customer provided. Details below and screenshot attached.

Summary: when attempting to load the quantized model on the t4-like instance we see repeated OOMs during KV cache allocate on long catalog prefix loads (~50k keys).
Impact: blocks end-to-end integration and kernel-level inference tests  currently prevents us from creating the staging endpoint for customer testing.
Initial assessment: likely kernel memory path allocation bug under this sequence pattern; reproduces consistently with the provided sample catalog.
Proposed mitigations (short term):
- Option A (fast): provision a larger instance (p3-equivalent) to avoid OOM for initial POC (costly for Redwood but fastest)  ETA to repro/test: 46 hrs
- Option B (workaround): reduce KV prefetch during initial runs + split catalog load into sharded prefix loads (requires schema side changes on Stellar and more integration work)  ETA: 12 business days

Next steps I recommend: 1) spin up a p3-equivalent instance to get the POC started while engineering tracks the kernel fix, 2) open an engineering escalation ticket (Ill do that now) and add details to the tracker.

Attachment: bug-screenshot.png


